function outcome(board)
    lines = [collect(row) for row in board]
    append!(lines, [[board[row][column] for row = 1:3] for column = 1:3])
    push!(lines, [board[i][i] for i = 1:3])
    push!(lines, [board[i][4-i] for i = 1:3])
    for line in lines
        if line[1] != '.' && all(==(line[1]), line)
            return string(line[1], " wins")
        end
    end
    return any(occursin('.', row) for row in board) ? "in progress" : "draw"
end

boards = [
    ["XXX", "OO.", "O.X"],
    ["X.O", ".X.", "O.."],
    ["XO.", ".OX", "XO."],
    ["XOX", "XOO", "OXX"],
    ["X.O", "XO.", "O.X"],
    ["XOX", "OXO", "OXX"],
]
for (number, board) in enumerate(boards)
    result = outcome(board)
    println("board ", number, ": ", result)
end
